en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3556 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:

"If the father embraces Islam, he leads his child to Islam. When the child reaches maturity, he is invited to accept Islam; if he refuses, he is to be killed.
However, if the child accepts Islam, they do not bring their parents into it, and there will be no inheritance between them."
